stage: post-freeze source selection for reading; inputs not yet frozen
selection_basis: Five different topics and study types, independently of model outputs. Public full texts found after the candidate freeze. Identity deduplicated against the recoverable prior index and this round's development sources; this does not establish non-exposure in pretraining or lost past sessions.

sources.title: Sleepmore in Seattle: Later school start times are associated with more sleep and better performance in high school students
sources.type: quantitative; school start time policy comparison
sources.reason: A real school policy comparison with objectively measured sleep and several educational outcomes; suitable for testing whether new writing connects a concrete question, design and contribution without inventing causal identification.

sources.title: Systematic investigation of inadequate food access at a large southeastern land grant university
sources.type: mixed methods; higher education basic needs
sources.reason: Survey patterns and students' written accounts concern access to food, housing and support. Tests joint interpretation, measurement and sample correspondence in a topic unlike the development tasks. Chosen over the nursing-student screening candidate for richer integration material and a clear CC BY reuse license.

sources.title: “爱而不亲”：留守儿童的亲子关系体验与建构
sources.type: qualitative; Chinese family and childhood research
sources.reason: A Chinese account of children's interpretations of parent-child relationships, allowing a transfer check of conceptual contrast and agency without turning qualitative accounts into population effects.

sources.title: epistemic violence and philosophy for children: toward an epistemically capacious community of inquiry
sources.reason: Distinguishes individual prejudice from the terms of an inquiry and uses classroom incidents to support an educational judgment. CC BY source permits a short attributed translation task with concepts and modal force preserved.

sources.title: The relationship between homework time and academic performance among K‐12: A systematic review
sources.reason: The distinction between assigning homework and identifying its optimum duration gives a concrete test of synthesis, limits and practical contribution across heterogeneous evidence.

screened_not_selected.reason: Public author manuscript found; replaced before any writing runs by the richer CC BY mixed-methods source H2. Not read in full and not counted as a distilled full text.
